title: Convert markdown in pasted text to rich text
reason: Requests applying the same live markdown-to-rich-text conversion to pasted text, especially headings such as `## Foo`. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Potential text-editing enhancement; Varve's paste parser and markdown conversion contract were not inspected.

title: Collapse workspace management items in the sidebar to free space for files
reason: Requests reducing vertical space used by infrequently used workspace controls so more file rows fit. The only comment supplies a screenshot; it was not replayed.

varveAssessment.assessment: This is an upstream hosted workspace sidebar density request, not a Varve canvas or marketing-site change.

title: Add folders to workspaces for organizing files
reason: Requests folders or another hierarchy for organizing hosted workspace files currently presented as a flat list. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: This depends on upstream workspace file service and persistence; no Varve feature direction follows directly.

title: Harden CI: two credentialed third-party actions are pinned to a mutable @master tag
reason: Identifies mutable third-party action refs in credentialed upstream workflows and offers a prepared fix. A maintainer thanks the author and says they will review/incorporate, but the retrieved comment does not confirm that it shipped.

varveAssessment.assessment: This is a worthwhile security pattern to compare against Varve workflow pinning separately; the upstream report does not establish Varve's current action references.

title: Emit interaction lifecycle and tool change events
reason: Requests public typed lifecycle events for more editor interactions and all tool transitions. It broadens the event seam discussed in #9500; no comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Potential extension-system improvement, but Varve's public event/action API and integration use cases need review before adding surface area.

title: "Stack Vertically" Re-orders items
reason: The maintainer confirms #10383 fixed both explicit-gap and auto-gap stacking by sorting spatially rather than preserving selection/z order; the follow-up thanks them.

varveAssessment.assessment: Potential layout-command regression comparison; Varve stacking order was not inspected or tested.

title: Draw tool does not auto-close shapes when drawn slowly
reason: The reply says #9930 should fix slow small loops by preventing under-measurement of densely sampled strokes, but asks the reporter to confirm on their trackpad before closing. Preserve this as a proposed, not confirmed, resolution.

varveAssessment.assessment: A strong real-pointer drawing regression lead; no Varve slow-stroke closure reproduction was performed.

title: Add a scale interaction distinct from resize
reason: Requests a transform mode that scales shape dimensions and attributes such as stroke, font, and radius, unlike ordinary resize. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: A substantial design feature; Varve's transform semantics, node property scaling, and serialization impact were not inspected.

title: Make the import file option on tldraw.com easier to discover
reason: Reports that hosted `.tldr` import exists but is hidden in the account/settings menu, where users do not look for file import. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: The hosted sidebar placement is not a Varve website or editor defect; no local import UX was evaluated.

title: Moving or resizing an image creates browser rendering artefacts
reason: The reporter provides a video and a later comment suggests the issue duplicates #8482. The media was not replayed, and the connection should be treated as the stated duplicate lead rather than an independently confirmed root cause.

varveAssessment.assessment: Canvas rendering artifacts require reproducing the described browser interaction and full-redraw oracle in Varve before changing pixel reuse or transforms.
